map.安全提示：油温过高会冒烟甚至自燃（约300℃以上），切勿离人。油面冒青烟即已达极: Safety tip: too-high oil temperature smokes and may even self-ignite (about 300°C and above); never leave unattended. When blue smoke rises from the oil surface it has reached the limit; turn off the heat and cool immediately.
map.油面平静无烟无响，投入筷子周围有细小气泡缓慢冒出。适合滑油、软炸。: Oil surface calm, no smoke, no sizzle; a chopstick dipped in gives tiny bubbles slowly rising. Suits velveting and soft-frying.
map.油面微动略有青烟，筷子周围气泡较多且有声响。适合炒、炸、煎。: Oil surface slightly moving with light blue smoke; more bubbles around the chopstick and a sizzle. Suits stir-fry, deep-fry, pan-fry.
map.油面冒青烟，筷子周围大量气泡翻腾。适合爆炒、复炸、炝锅。: Oil surface smoking; vigorous bubbling around the chopstick. Suits flash-fry, re-fry and fragrance-popping.
map.滑炒肉丝、上浆鱼片需低温（三四成热约 120–150℃）下锅，锁水嫩滑不粘；油温: Velvet-stir pork shreds and battered fish fillets go in at low temperature (30%–40% heat about 120–150°C) to lock moisture, stay tender and not stick; too high burns outside while raw inside.
map.炸制（五六十成热约 160–190℃）按炸不同食材分阶段，先中温定型再升温逼油，: Deep-frying (50%–60% heat about 160–190°C) is staged by ingredient: first medium heat to set shape, then raise heat to drive out oil, achieving crisp outside tender inside.
map.爆香葱姜蒜、炝锅用七八成热（约 200℃ 上下），入料即响、香气迸发但不焦；超过: Fragrance-pop scallion/ginger/garlic and fragrant oil use 70%–80% heat (about 200°C around); in goes the ingredient with a sizzle, aroma bursts without burning; beyond that it smokes and turns bitter.
map.竹筷插入油中，四周冒细密小泡（约 120–150℃）即三四成热，适合滑炒上浆；若: Insert a bamboo chopstick into the oil; tiny dense bubbles around (about 120–150°C) means 30%–40% heat, good for velveting; if lots of rapid bubbles with light blue smoke (about 200°C+) it is too high, remove from heat and cool before adding food.

map.上浆食材低温下锅淀粉糊化形成保护膜、锁住水分，高温会瞬间结壳致粘锅且内部不熟。: Battered ingredients at low temperature: starch gelatinizes into a protective film, locking moisture; high temperature instantly crusts and sticks while the inside stays uncooked.
